choices.misconception: Table salt is made of NaCl molecules.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option Salt is made of NaCl molecules, each one sodium atom joined to one chlorine atom as their answer to this question.
rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: Table salt is made of NaCl molecules.. The slip: The formula NaCl looks like one joined unit, like the formulas of real molecules. The fix: Salt is a giant ionic lattice: NaCl just gives the ratio, there are no separate NaCl molecules. In class, draw one corner of the lattice and ask students to circle a single NaCl molecule - they cannot, because each ion belongs to the whole pattern, not to one partner.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
